Kerala High Court Rules Woman Sole Owner of House Bought with Father's Funds

The Kerala High Court has ruled that a woman is the sole owner of a house purchased using funds from her father, even though the property was registered in both her and her husband's names. The court directed the husband to vacate the premises. The ruling clarified ownership rights in cases where a property is bought with funds provided by one party's family but registered jointly.
